name: [LIVE EVENT] SMASH Walls For Brainrots!
desc:
Welcome to Smash Walls For Brainrots!

👊Smash through walls to discover brainrots!
🧠Collect brainrots and place them on your plot!
💸Watch your brainrots earn you cash over time!
🧤Upgrade your gloves to smash even harder walls!
🌍Explore new biomes for rarer brainrots!

Remember to like & favorite the game for updates! 👍⭐
